reason: A dynamic Cordis plugin that adds a draggable, animated emoji desktop pet and interactive character controls to the DeepSeek Harness web UI overlay.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加可拖拽、带动画并支持点击互动和角色切换的表情桌面宠物。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable, animated emoji desktop pet with click interactions and character switching to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

capabilities: injects a client-side overlay into the DSH web UI
adds draggable and pointer-based pet interactions
injects CSS styles and manages timers
registers and cleans up a dynamic plugin lifecycle
